title: Flight Announcements Training
intro: Listen to professional flight announcements and practice your cabin crew communication skills. These audio recordings cover standard, safety, and service announcements used in commercial aviation.
trainingTip: Practice these announcements regularly to improve your pronunciation, tone, and professional delivery. Record yourself and compare with these reference recordings.

announcements.title: Welcome Onboard
announcements.script: Good morning/afternoon/evening ladies and gentlemen. On behalf of the entire crew, I would like to welcome you aboard Flight [Number] to [Destination]. Please pay attention as we go through important safety information.

announcements.title: Safety Instructions - English
announcements.script: Please direct your attention to the flight attendants as we demonstrate the safety features of this aircraft. Your seat cushion can be used as a flotation device. Please ensure your seat belt is securely fastened. There are several emergency exits located throughout the cabin, including two in the front, two over the wings, and two at the rear of the aircraft. Please take a moment to locate your nearest exit.

announcements.title: Safety Instructions - Hindi
announcements.script: कृपया अपना ध्यान फ्लाइट अटेंडेंट्स की ओर दें क्योंकि हम इस विमान की सुरक्षा विशेषताओं का प्रदर्शन करेंगे। आपकी सीट कुशन को फ्लोटेशन डिवाइस के रूप में इस्तेमाल किया जा सकता है। कृपया सुनिश्चित करें कि आपका सीट बेल्ट सुरक्षित रूप से बंधा हुआ है।

announcements.title: Takeoff Preparation
announcements.script: Ladies and gentlemen, we are now ready for departure. Please ensure that your seatbacks and tray tables are in their full upright position, your seat belt is securely fastened, and all carry-on luggage is safely stowed in the overhead bins or under the seat in front of you. Thank you for your cooperation.

announcements.title: Flight Delay - Weather
announcements.script: Ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking. Due to adverse weather conditions at our destination, we will be experiencing a slight delay in our departure. We expect to be airborne in approximately 30 minutes. We appreciate your patience and understanding. For your convenience, you may disembark the aircraft if you wish.

announcements.title: Meal Service - Vegetarian
announcements.script: Ladies and gentlemen, we will now commence our meal service. For passengers who requested vegetarian meals, we are pleased to offer you a specially prepared vegetarian option today. Please raise your call button if you have ordered a vegetarian meal, and one of our flight attendants will be happy to serve you. Enjoy your meal.

announcements.title: Meal Service - Non-Vegetarian
announcements.script: Ladies and gentlemen, we will now begin our meal service. For passengers who have ordered non-vegetarian meals, our cabin crew will begin serving from the front of the aircraft. We have prepared a delicious meal option for you today. If you need anything additional, please do not hesitate to contact one of our flight attendants.

announcements.title: Turbulence Warning
announcements.script: Ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain. We are now entering an area of turbulence. Please return to your seats immediately and fasten your seat belts. Please refrain from moving about the cabin until the seat belt sign has been turned off. We will keep you informed. Thank you for your cooperation.

announcements.title: Duty-Free Shopping
announcements.script: Ladies and gentlemen, we are now offering our duty-free service. Our cabin crew will be passing through the cabin with our exclusive collection of duty-free items including perfumes, cosmetics, chocolates, and souvenirs. If you would like to make a purchase, please raise your call button. Prices are displayed in both local currency and US dollars.

announcements.title: Preparing for Landing
announcements.script: Ladies and gentlemen, we will be landing in approximately 20 minutes. The local time at [Destination] is [Time]. The weather is [Weather]. Please return to your seats, make sure your seatbelt is fastened, and ensure that your seatback and tray table are in their upright position. All electronic devices must be switched off and stowed securely at this time.

announcements.title: Final Approach
announcements.script: Ladies and gentlemen, we are now making our final approach to [Destination] International Airport. Please ensure that your seat belt is securely fastened. All flight attendants, please be seated for landing. We anticipate landing in approximately five minutes. Thank you for flying with us today.

announcements.title: Disembarkation
announcements.script: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to [Destination]. Local time is [Time] and the outside temperature is [Temperature] degrees Celsius. Please remain seated with your seat belt fastened until the aircraft has come to a complete stop. We hope you had a pleasant flight with us today, and we look forward to serving you again.
